metric: LODO Kendall tau-b on real cervical NOALL (label-free) frozen embeddings
note: n=35 donors (31 normals: 30 ecto_Pxxx + N_HPV; 4 diseased: HSIL_HPV + CA_HPV_1/2 + cervical_cancer_1). Label-free NOALL encoder saw every donor's expression (never labels); the ridge severity probe is trained on 34 donors and tested on the held-out donor (standard linear-probe LODO, transductive in X only). Positive but weak and seed-unstable transfer (1/3 seeds p<0.05) grades as suggestive under the pre-registered rules — partial cross-donor disease-axis information survives complete label removal, in contrast to the identity-confounding simulation arm.
